verdict.rationale: Calendly's core product is a shareable booking link that syncs live calendar availability, with docs and community evidence confirming calendar sync, availability display, and single-click booking that eliminates back-and-forth (calendly-docs-15, calendly-docs-41, calendly-docs-42, calendly-comm-2, calendly-comm-3, calendly-comm-6). Minor caveats exist (dependency on Google Calendar sync per calendly-comm-10, and some social pushback on link-sharing etiquette) but these don't contradict core functionality. Missing for 10: fully independent quantitative usability study beyond anecdotal HN comments.
